name: oot_enemy_stinger
author: Skijer
description: Ocarina of Time's Stinger in Majora's Mask: it lurks under the floor with only its eyes showing, leaps out when you step on it and dives at you from the air; its water kin swims in deep water and rams you. Custom enemies oot.stinger and oot.stinger_water, sharing the soul soul.oot.stinger. Uses OoT Asset Loader resources.
